== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Disarmed]]. One column per published text state in date order: the printed card, Decipher's errata, and each Players Committee errata image (slip, disc card, E card, D-E1 card). The stamp row describes the mark on each image. Revised, Japanese, foil and Virtual printings stay in Versions. Yellow highlights mark words changed from the previous column. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Reprints: [[Disarmed (Unlimited)]] (1996) prints the words of the Original column; only notation differs, so it has no column of its own.
